flagged.title: Representing Algorithms: Pseudo-code, Flowcharts and Trace Tables
flagged.reason: Teaching students that flowchart loops always exit and loop back from the 'No' branch (F2) is a misconception that can cause students to lose marks when drawing or tracing flowcharts with positive loop conditions.

mark_affecting.quote: If you're drawing a loop, you're literally going to draw an arrow curving all the way back up from the no exit to an earlier step.
